title: MSFS Marketplace Update: NEW HJet HA420 & PMDG 737‑600 take over the skies!
description:
February 22, 2026 brings another exciting Microsoft Flight Simulator Marketplace Update! This week delivers two must‑have aircraft for PC simmers, including the sleek FlightFX HJet HA420 and the highly requested PMDG 737‑600. Let’s take a look at what landed in the hangar today.

✈️ New aircrafts added this week (PC)
The following aircrafts were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🛫 FlightFX: HJet HA420 (A popular light business jet with incredible efficiency)
🛫 PMDG Simulations: PMDG 737‑600 (A high‑fidelity short‑haul Boeing classic)

🎨 New Liveries added this week (PC)
The following liveries were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🎨 jedstudio: JEDS T‑38A Talon Thunderbirds Liveries (Iconic USAF display team look)
🎨 PMDG Simulations: PMDG 737‑600 World Livery Pack (Global airline variety added!)

If you enjoyed this roundup, don’t forget to like the video, subscribe for weekly MSFS updates, and drop a comment letting me know which aircraft you’re picking up!

Thanks for watching 
✈️ See you in the skies!
